([[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]]) | college = [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]] (2024–2025) | highlights = * Third-team [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East]] (2025) * [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman team (2025) }} '''Thomas Sorber''' (born December 25, 2005) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown Hoyas]]. ==Early life and high school career== Sorber grew up in [[Trenton, New Jersey]] and initially attended [[Trenton Catholic Academy]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nj.com/sports/2024/12/nj-native-thomas-sorber-wants-to-be-georgetowns-next-great-big-man-and-the-nba-is-already-on-notice.html|title=N.J. native wants to be Georgetown’s next great big man, and the NBA is already noticing|first=Adam|last=Zagoria|website=[[NJ.com]]|date=December 20, 2024|access-date=January 9, 2025}} He transferred to [[Archbishop Ryan High School]] in [[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]] after his freshman year.{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/high-school-sports/pennsylvania/thomas-sorber-basketball-recruiting-archbishop-ryan-20221222.html|title=How Archbishop Ryan’s Thomas Sorber became the center of attention for college basketball coaches|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=December 22, 2022|access-date=January 9, 2025}} As a sophomore, Sorber averaged 16.5 points per game and led the [[Philadelphia Catholic League]] in rebounding.{{cite web|url=https://northeasttimes.com/2022/03/11/ryan-big-man-having-fun-at-new-home/|title=Ryan big man having fun at new home|work=[[Northeast Times]]|date=March 11, 2022|access-date=January 10, 2025}} Sorber was rated a four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and committed to playing college basketball for [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]] over offers from [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami (Florida)]], [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence]], and [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]].{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/high-school-sports/archbishop-ryan-thomas-sorber-commits-college-basketball-georgetown-20230517.html|title=Archbishop Ryan center Thomas Sorber commits to Georgetown|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=May 17, 2023|access-date=January 10, 2025}} ==College career== Sorber scored 20 points and grabbed 13 rebounds in his college debut against Lehigh.{{cite web|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2024/11/06/georgetown-lehigh-cooley-sorber/|title=After its latest roster reset, Georgetown opens with a win over Lehigh|work=[[The Washington Post]]|date=November 6, 2024|access-date=January 10, 2025}}{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/georgetown-s-thomas-sorber-has-continued-climbing-nba-draft-boards|title=Georgetown's Thomas Sorber Has Continued Climbing NBA Draft Boards|first=Jace|last=Derryberry|website=[[SI.com]]|date=December 3, 2024|access-date=January 12, 2025}} He scored 25 points with nine rebounds in the next game against Fairfield and was named the [[Big East Conference]] Rookie of the Week for the first week of the season.{{cite web|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2024/11/09/georgetown-hoyas-basketball-fairfield-thomas-sorber/|title=Thomas Sorber looks the part as Georgetown earns its second straight win|work=[[The Washington Post]]|date=November 9, 2024|access-date=January 10, 2025}}{{cite web|url=https://guhoyas.com/news/2024/11/11/mens-basketball-thomas-sorber-named-big-east-freshman-of-the-week.aspx|title=Thomas Sorber Named BIG EAST Freshman of the Week|website=GUHoyas.com|date=November 11, 2024|access-date=January 10, 2025}} At the conclusion of his freshman season, Sorber was named to the All-Big East Third Team and was a unanimous selection to the Big East All-Freshman team.{{cite web|url=https://guhoyas.com/news/2025/3/9/mens-basketball-peavy-named-all-big-east-first-team-sorber-tabbed-third-team-and-unanimous-selection-to-all-freshman-team.aspx|title=Peavy Named All-BIG EAST First Team; Sorber Tabbed Third Team and Unanimous Selection to All-Freshman Team|work=GUHoyas.com|date=March 9, 2025|access-date=April 29, 2025}} As a freshman, he averaged 14.5 points, 8.5 rebounds and 2.4 assists per game. On March 27, 2025, Sorber declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/44433051/hoyas-sorber-declare-nba-draft-keep-options-open|title=Hoyas' Sorber to declare for NBA draft, keep options open|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 27, 2025|access-date=May 16, 2025}} He later decided to remain in the draft.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/45151088/bryant-sorber-powell-philon-remain-nba-draft|title=Bryant, Sorber, Powell, Philon to remain in NBA draft|work=[[ESPN]]|date=May 14, 2025|access-date=May 16, 2025}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2024–25 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] | 24 || 23 || 31.3 || .532 || .162 || .724 || 8.5 || 2.4 || 1.5 || 2.0 || 14.5 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://guhoyas.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/thomas-sorber/16078 Georgetown Hoyas bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Sorber, Thomas}} [[Category:2005 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Trenton, New Jersey]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball players]] [[Category:Power forwards]] [[Category:Trenton Catholic Academy alumni]]
